title: Sinusoidal-forcing scenes v1
description: Sealed boxes of water pushed by one forcing blob whose centre and strength vary sinusoidally, on four grid shapes at 8 and 16 cells per metre. These are the scenes the earlier models were fitted and confirmed on; every scene labelled reserved has already been used to check an earlier model. The scene table is surrogate/datasets/definitions/sinusoidal-v1.json. The command simulates the train and development scenes one after another on one CPU thread and writes them under sinusoidal-v1/ in the output directory. Reserved scenes are for final checks only and are not generated here (surrogate.datasets generate needs --include-reserved for them).
